name: Non Believers
overview: Scripture reveals that non believers are described as those who deny God’s existence and live in corruption, as seen in Psalms 14:1. Trusting fully in the Lord rather than human understanding is essential (Proverbs 3:5), and merely professing faith without doing God’s will is insufficient for entering His kingdom (Matthew 7:21). Yet, God’s love extends to all, offering eternal life to anyone who believes in Jesus Christ (John 3:16), and even those once blind to truth can have their eyes opened by Him (John 9:30). The revelation given to John underscores the certainty of these truths and the unfolding of God’s plan (Revelation 1:1). This foundation informs important considerations about relationships with non believers, including dating, marriage, and their eventual acceptance of Christ.
